  ],
  "n_predictors": 12,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.78,
  "rationale": "The added columns directly realise the exploratory intent: they decompose the free-text open_response into a set of named, human-interpretable themes as binary presence flags that can each be grouped and cross-tabulated against satisfaction, and further sliced by role, grade, and subject. The themes are semantically distinct (tech issues, engagement, teacher quality, equity, social connection, outcomes valence) and several have well-balanced splits (engagement 76/174, hands_on 91/159, social_connection 92/158) supporting robust comparison. Weaknesses: a few themes are quite rare (equity 11, tech 14), making segment estimates noisy, and open_response_sentiment is near-constant (91% neutral) while largely restating the satisfaction signal, so it contributes little interpretive lift. Overall this is a genuine, interpretable relationship-opening set rather than opaque scores, so it substantially satisfies the claim."
}
